lock: TITO, a baby elephant toddler. Powder-blue body, very big round ears with peach-pink insides, short soft trunk curled up at the tip, big glossy dark-brown eyes with white sparkle highlights, rosy cheeks, a tiny tuft of three hairs on top of the head, wearing small sunny-yellow overalls with one round red button, short chubby arms and legs, small tail.
room: Bright cozy playroom with light wooden floor, round pastel rug, three open toy boxes in a row colored red, blue and yellow, big window with soft daylight.

song.title: Cada juguete a su casita
song.lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Uy! ¡Qué desorden!
¡A ordenar!
[Verse]
La pelota roja, a la caja roja.
El carrito azul, a la caja azul.
[Chorus]
Cada juguete a su casita, ¡uno, dos, tres!
Cada juguete a su casita, ¡qué bonito es!
[Bridge]
El patito amarillo… ¿aquí? ¡No!
¡A la caja amarilla!
[Outro]
¡Todo en su lugar!

shots.frame: Medium-wide shot: the baby elephant sits on the rug while colorful toys tumble down around him, a red ball, a blue toy car, a yellow rubber duck and green blocks in mid-air, his big ears raised in surprise.
shots.motion: Toys tumble down and bounce on the floor around the baby elephant, he flaps his big ears in surprise and covers his eyes with his trunk. Static camera.

shots.frame: Wide shot: the baby elephant stands proudly in front of three open toy boxes colored red, blue and yellow, trunk raised and pointing forward, determined smile.
shots.motion: The baby elephant raises his trunk like a little trumpet and marches in place, determined and happy. Static camera.

shots.frame: Medium shot: the baby elephant holds a shiny red ball curled in his trunk above the open red toy box.
shots.motion: The baby elephant lifts the red ball with his trunk and drops it into the red box, it bounces inside, he smiles. Static camera.
shots.lyric: La pelota roja, a la caja roja.

shots.frame: Medium shot: the baby elephant pushes a small blue toy car with his trunk toward the open blue toy box.
shots.motion: The baby elephant pushes the blue toy car with his trunk, it rolls and drops into the blue box. Gentle camera follow.
shots.lyric: El carrito azul, a la caja azul.

shots.frame: Wide shot: the baby elephant dances happily in the middle of the playroom, ears flapping, one foot raised, toys hopping toward their colored boxes.
shots.motion: The baby elephant dances and spins, ears flapping on the beat, toys hop by themselves into the matching colored boxes. Slight camera sway.
shots.lyric: Cada juguete a su casita, ¡uno, dos, tres!

shots.frame: Close-up: the baby elephant holds a yellow rubber duck with his trunk above the BLUE toy box, head tilted, puzzled face.
shots.motion: The baby elephant hesitates holding the yellow duck over the blue box, tilts his head and blinks, puzzled. Slow push-in.

shots.frame: Medium shot: the baby elephant happily places the yellow rubber duck into the YELLOW toy box, trunk raised in joy.
shots.motion: The baby elephant shakes his head no, moves the duck to the yellow box and drops it in, then raises his trunk and trumpets with joy. Static camera.

shots.frame: Wide shot: the tidy playroom, the baby elephant sits proudly next to the three full toy boxes, a red ball balanced on top of the red box.
shots.motion: The baby elephant sits proudly and smiles, then the red ball rolls off the box toward the camera and he gasps. Static camera.
shots.sfx: sparkle, then soft 'boing' of the ball
